newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dentsply EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dentsply EPS view cut.

text.p: Mesirow Financial Inc said it reduced its earnings estimates for Dentsply International Inc to $2.77 a share from $2.87 for 1997 and to $3.23 a share from $3.30 for 1998.
-- In a report dated Monday, Mesirow said Dentsply recently issued a press release indicating that second quarter earnings would be materially below expectations.
-- Mesirow said its rating on Dentsply remains a buy, adding, "we believe the majority of the damage has already been done at this point."
-- "We note the strong balance sheet and prodigious free cash generation of the business and believe down side risk is limited from the current price," Mesirow said.
